:::{#def-exponential-decay}
#### Exponential decay

Let $\iterpoint{\steplen}{0} > 0$ be the [step length](#def-gradient-descent) before update $1$,
and let $\decay \in (0, 1)$ be a decay factor.
The **exponential decay** schedule is

$$
\iterpoint{\steplen}{t} \eqdef \iterpoint{\steplen}{0}\,\decay^t.
$$

:::
